profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Cyber Security Practitioner | I lead teams by building trust
profile.summary:
Outside of work, I’m a father of three, which has probably made me more patient, more direct, and more intentional about how I spend time. I’m looking for a role where the problems are interesting, the bar is high, and the people are genuinely collaborative.

In my career as a senior software engineer, I've spent most of the last decade building backend systems on the JVM—mainly in the network security world at Cisco. I worked on a platform that shipped through roughly 20 release cycles, and I’ve been in the weeds on the kinds of problems that show up in real systems: JVM profiling and performance fixes, service-to-service communication, and the slow, necessary work of moving from a monolith to microservices.

One project I’m especially proud of was helping move our Java stack off a proprietary JCE provider and onto FIPS-approved Bouncy Castle, rolling the change through a bunch of interconnected services without breaking production. I also care a lot about how software gets built, not just what gets built—clean code, pragmatic automation, and tests that actually protect you (unit, component, end-to-end, and system).

What people tend to notice about me is that I’m calm under pressure and easy to work with. I’ve partnered closely with product, QA, security/compliance, and other engineering teams to turn fuzzy requirements into shippable work. One of my most proud moments in my career was stepping in during a release crisis, onboarding new team members, and getting a critical feature over the line as the technical lead of the project. Ask me more about it!

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description: At OMNY Health, I support the development and reliability of the company’s healthcare data platform by contributing to both infrastructure and application engineering. My work spans improving CI/CD pipelines, strengthening cloud and containerized environments, and enhancing platform security, performance, and automation. I collaborate across teams to ensure the platform remains scalable, stable, and aligned with best practices.

positions.title: Full Stack DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
At Radarsign, I help modernize and operate the cloud platform that powers connected traffic safety devices. My focus is making releases safer and faster, improving reliability, and reducing operational friction through automation and better infrastructure practices.

• Upgraded a legacy .NET API to .NET 8 on AWS to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability

• Built reproducible EC2 AMIs using EC2 Image Builder, replacing manual VM builds and reducing configuration drift

• Designed and maintained CI/CD workflows across AWS and Azure to speed up deployments and reduce release risk

• Supported cloud security and network operations with proactive monitoring and controls

• Added cloud cost visibility using AWS Cost Explorer dashboards to guide infrastructure decisions
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · .NET Framework · Network Administration

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Cisco, by way of acquisition of Lancope Inc, I helped build back-end software for an enterprise network security analytics platform—formerly known as Stealthwatch and now called Cisco Secure Network Analytics. 

My work sat at the intersection of backend engineering, security/compliance, and delivery—shipping features across a large distributed system while keeping reliability and performance front and center.

• Delivered 20+ projects across multiple release cycles in an Agile environment, partnering closely with product, engineering leadership, QA, and security/compliance teams

• Modernized a legacy Java platform into a microservice architecture (25+ Docker services), improving scalability and simplifying deployments

• Replaced proprietary cryptography with FIPS-compliant Bouncy Castle across dozens of services, coordinating rollout dependencies across global service owners

• Built and improved CI/CD and automated testing frameworks to reduce release risk and speed up delivery

• Investigated and fixed production performance issues using JVM profiling and load testing to reduce latency and improve reliability

• Stepped in during a high-pressure release and helped align scope, unblock delivery, and onboard new team members
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Cybersecurity · Networking · Software Design · Java Virtual Machine (JVM) · Cross-functional Team Leadership

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: Web development using GWT, Java, and the Spring Framework.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Software Development · Front-End Development · Leadership Development · Public Speaking

positions.title: Quality Assurance and Release Manager
positions.description:
Designed and executed QA test plans for multiple in-flight ASP.NET and Microsoft Sharepoint projects by collaborating with development and project management teams.

Implemented and executed Visual Studio 2008 deployment scripts for multiple environments throughout the SDLC.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Quality Assurance · Software Deployment

positions.title: QA Engineer Co-op
positions.description: Conducted advance testing techniques including load, stress, and performance testing. Worked with the Quality Assurance team to deliver high quality and on-time software to over 800 customers. Delivered two successful service packs within 1.5 years.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Quality Assurance · Software Testing · Bug Tracking · Troubleshooting

volunteerExperiences.description: Dad’s Garage is a 501(c)3 nonprofit with the mission to transform people, communities, and perspectives through laughter. Our volunteers primarily work with the Front of House to uphold the patron experience: working at the Box Office/Will Call, scanning tickets, greeting and ushering guests, resetting the house and lobby, and performing any additional tasks that may arise during the evening.

William's House is an organization with the mission to empowering men in recovery, with children, experiencing situational poverty to work a track towards self-sufficiency. As a volunteer, I have assisted in their IT Administration including Microsoft 365 Administration and collaboration with their digital marketing team.
